description: This file defines the AuthorizationControl class which manages authorization rules, approval workflows, and validation logic for transactions within the ERPNext system, including user roles, approval limits, and specific authorization rules.

classes.name: AuthorizationControl
classes.description: A class that handles authorization rules, approval workflows, and validation for transactions in ERPNext.

methods.name: get_appr_user_role
methods.description: Retrieves approving users and roles based on maximum amount and authorization rules.

methods.name: validate_auth_rule
methods.description: Validates authorization rules based on the transaction amount, type, and context.

methods.name: bifurcate_based_on_type
methods.description: Determines authorization based on user, role, or global rules depending on the context.

methods.name: validate_approving_authority
methods.description: Validates if the current user has the authority to approve a transaction based on rules and limits.

methods.name: get_value_based_rule
methods.description: Fetches the applicable authorization rule based on employee and transaction amount.

methods.name: get_approver_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name(s) of approvers for specific transaction types like Expense Claim or Appraisal.
